subject: RFP 3127 — Cloud partner rotation: subprocessor inventory & impact assessment
messages:
From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@bigfinance.com>
To: connor.obrien@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@bigfinance.com
Date: 2026-08-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: RFP 3127 — subprocessor update & rotation notice (CloudAtlas)

Hi Connor / Laura,

As part of our RFP review (RFP-3127) we received information that one of your cloud partners, CloudAtlas Solutions, is planning a platform consolidation that will migrate certain services from us-east-1 to a third-party regional provider in Q4. Our security team needs: 

1) A current subprocessor inventory (name, purpose, data types accessed, region).
2) Any planned changes or rotations (who, timeline, fallback).
3) Attestations for controls covering the new provider (SOC2/ISO certs, encryption in transit/at rest, KMS/HSM usage).

We have a firm deadline of 2026-09-03 for updated artifacts to complete our vendor risk assessment. Please confirm whether you can provide the inventory and any supporting assurance documents before that date.

Thanks,
Maria Gomez
Vendor Risk Manager
BigFinance Inc.
procurement@bigfinance.com

--
Attachment: RFP-3127-questionnaire.pdf (referenced)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@bigfinance.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-30T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFP 3127 — subprocessor update & rotation notice (CloudAtlas)

Hi Maria — thanks for the heads up and deadline. Quick status: we can provide a consolidated subprocessor inventory and initial impact notes by EOD 2026-08-31, and additional assurance artifacts (third-party certs and SLA addenda) by 2026-09-02.

Attached is our current inventory export (redwood_subprocessors_v2.csv) — it lists our primary subprocessors, purpose, and region columns. Important callouts in the file: CloudAtlas provides network edge routing (edge cache and regional ingress) for a subset of our EU/US CDN endpoints; the planned consolidation you referenced affects only their US-east routing partner for logging ingestion pipelines (no model or training data is sent).

Next steps I propose:
- Soojin to confirm the security posture for the CloudAtlas change (certs, KMS usage).
- We prepare an SLA addendum for your legal team describing the fallback policy and notification windows.

I’ll follow up with a short summary of potential impact (latency, DR) once Soojin has reviewed.

Connor O'Brien
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Attachment: redwood_subprocessors_v2.csv (CSV inventory, 42 rows)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@bigfinance.com>, connor.obrien@redwood.ai
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-01T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFP 3127 — subprocessor update & rotation notice (CloudAtlas)

On Fri, Aug 30, 2026 at 11:05 AM Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Attached is our current inventory export (redwood_subprocessors_v2.csv) — it lists our primary subprocessors, purpose, and region columns.

Hi Maria / Connor — security team here. I reviewed the inventory and CloudAtlas's note on the platform consolidation. Summary:

- Impact scope: limited to log ingestion and edge routing for a small cohort of US tenants; no model weights or raw customer PII are moved to the CloudAtlas partner.
- Controls: CloudAtlas continues to support TLS1.2+ for in-transit encryption and AES-256 for at-rest encryption. They indicated KMS integration for envelope encryption; we require HSM-backed KMS for the affected routing partner — that is reflected in the attached assurance summary.
- Required artifacts for BigFinance RFP: SOC 2 Type II report (latest 12 months), encryption architecture diagram, and the partner's SLAs for data residency/fallover.

I've attached a short assurance summary we received from CloudAtlas; I still need their HSM confirmation in writing. If BigFinance requires HSM-backed key material, we will request an SLA addendum and a migration/fallback timeline from CloudAtlas.

Soojin Lee
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai

Attachment: cloudatlas-assurance-summary.pdf (3 pages)

From: Partner Support <partner@cloudatlas.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, connor.obrien@redwood.ai, maria.gomez@bigfinance.com
Date: 2026-09-01T13:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFP 3127 — CloudAtlas platform consolidation: attestation and SLA addendum

Hi Soojin / Connor / Maria,

Thanks for the flag. Quick attestation from CloudAtlas: the US-east routing partner we intend to consolidate to uses a managed HSM for KMS operations and maintains SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 coverage. We attach the SLA addendum draft that includes notification windows (30 days for material changes), fallover timelines, and a clause for at-rest encryption standards.

Notes:
- Migration window: target week of 2026-10-18 with a two-week rollback window.
- Fallback: automatic routing to the primary CloudAtlas backbone for 72 hours in case of incidents, with manual escalation afterwards.

We can provide a signed attestation and a scanned SOC 2 bundle under NDA if BigFinance requires it.

Regards,
Evan Park
Partner Operations Lead
CloudAtlas Solutions
partner@cloudatlas.com

Attachment: cloudatlas-sla-addendum.docx (draft)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@bigfinance.com>, partner@cloudatlas.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-02T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFP 3127 — Cloud partner rotation: subprocessor inventory & impact assessment

Hi all — quick wrap: thanks for the quick turnarounds. To confirm next items and owners before your 2026-09-03 cutoff:

- Soojin: will secure written HSM confirmation from CloudAtlas and the SOC 2 bundle by 2026-09-02 EOD.
- CloudAtlas (Evan): please confirm the final migration week and sign the SLA addendum; provide the attestation PDF.
- BigFinance (Maria): once you confirm NDA routing for the SOC 2 bundle, we will upload the artifacts to the shared Drive link and send a DocuSign envelope for the SLA addendum.

Related artifacts uploaded shortly: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRFP-3127 (internal access), and I’ll open JIRA SUP-7421 to track the legal review of the SLA clause. We’ll also route the signed addendum through DocuSign: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABCDEF-123456

If that matches everyone's expectation I’ll mark the RFP item as satisfied and move it to legal review.

Connor O'Brien
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai
